title: What if asteroid Apophis hit Earth in 2029? ☄️
subject: asteroid
description:
Would you go outside to watch it pass? 👇

Asteroid Apophis, 1,115 feet wide, will pass about 20,000 miles above Earth on April 13, 2029, closer than geosynchronous satellites. Early estimates gave it a 2.7% chance of impact; 2021 radar observations ruled out any impact for at least 100 years.

Sources: NASA ("Apophis Facts"), NASA JPL ("NASA Analysis: Earth Is Safe From Asteroid Apophis for 100-Plus Years", 2021), The Planetary Society ("Will Apophis hit Earth?")
tags: what if an asteroid hit earth

scenes.text: In 2029, an asteroid will fly below our satellites.
Apophis is 1,115 feet wide, and on April 13 it passes 20,000 miles above the ground.
Soon after its discovery in 2004, its odds of hitting us that day reached 2.7%.
A hit would release over 1,000 megatons, with damage reaching several hundred kilometers away.
Radar in March 2021 ruled out any impact for at least 100 years.
Instead, Earth's gravity will twist it, and may shake loose small landslides on its surface.
